offeredEvidence.quote: What is the processing time for business filings? With the exception of annual reports, documents are usually processed the same day they are received, but it may take up to three business days.

standardProcessing.statement: What is the processing time for business filings? With the exception of annual reports, documents are usually processed the same day they are received, but it may take up to three business days.

notes: Kentucky's 'no' is rested on three pages read in full, not on one missed page. The FAQ quoted here is the office answering the turnaround question in its own words, and the answer is routine same-day processing with no paid faster track beside it. The complete fee list on the Fees page carries no expedite line for any entity type, and KRS 14A.2-060 — the statute that enumerates what the Secretary of State 'shall collect', down to a catch-all of $15 for 'any other document required or permitted to be filed by this chapter' — prices no expedited handling either, and a fee the statute does not establish is not one the office may charge. This is a weaker 'no' than a state that says 'we do not offer expedited services' outright, and the notes say so. On standardProcessing: the FAQ does not distinguish online from mail filings, so both day-range fields mirror the same sentence; 'same day' is encoded as min 0 and 'up to three business days' as max 3 — the statement is the artifact, the range is convenience.

sources.title: Business Filings FAQs — processing time: usually same day, up to three business days; no expedited option mentioned
Fees — complete filing-fee list, consulted; LLC Articles of Organization $40.00, no expedite line for any entity type
KRS 14A.2-060 Fees and miscellaneous charges — consulted in full; enumerates the Secretary of State's fees and establishes no expedited-service charge
